description: This file defines a middleware component for ASP.NET Core that handles exceptions occurring during HTTP request processing. It intercepts exceptions, logs them, and returns appropriate JSON error responses based on exception types.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for catching exceptions in the request pipeline, logging them, and returning standardized error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method invoked per HTTP request. Calls the next delegate and handles exceptions if they occur.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Static helper method that processes exceptions, sets HTTP response codes, serializes error messages, and writes the response.
